visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: Inspected the front, top and isometric views of this round; they are byte-identical to the renders inspected before the last source change, which touched only Saturn's ring. 116 x 152 x 9.00. Grid grooves are cut as fine lines across the land cells and stop at every terrain pocket. Pockets for trap c1 and belt cells b4 and c4 are present and open upward; probed at Z 8 there is air inside each pocket, material on every land cell, and material at Z 2 under every pocket floor. Flat underside, nothing missing, extra or intersecting.
